feeds.title: Watch Guy
feeds.description: Christian Dannemann has been working as a professional watchmaker since January 2012, and has been a member of The British Watch & Clock Makers' Guild since April 2015. The blog shows his attempts and failures at fixing and servicing watches.

feeds.title: Chronopolis Watches Blog
feeds.description: I'm Lee. Owner of the one-man operation that is Chronopolis Watches. I like to think of myself as a Robin Hood of the watch world. I'm a passionate fan of affordable watches and I try and pass on my knowledge and enthusiasm. I run a watch blog, posting multiple times a week. I do round up lists and watch reviews. I've been in the watch trade for several years and have extensive knowledge of affordable watches.

feeds.title: Paulin Watches News
feeds.description: Situated in Glasgow's west end is Paulin's workshop, a creative space that acts as an office, shop, studio, and leather workshop. Open seven days a week, space offers a bespoke service for leather straps, instantly providing you with a personal touch to your watch.
